task.title: Clean adapter schemas and command helpers
task.summary: Reduce low-risk duplication and helper cleanup findings in Pi adapter schemas, registration, commands, and compaction glue without changing public tool schemas or command behavior.

goal.outcome: Adapter/schema duplicate-code and small command-helper findings drop while public schemas and Pi command behavior remain compatible.
acceptance: Repeated adapter registration blocks are extracted into small behavior-preserving helpers where clarity improves.
Schema duplicate blocks are consolidated only when validation semantics and deprecated compatibility aliases remain explicit.
Async helpers without await are made synchronous unless an interface requires Promise behavior, and touched boolean parameters become options objects where call-site clarity improves.
Package, command, and compaction smoke behavior remains compatible.
non_goals: Do not refactor Pi UI manager/theme modules in this task.
Do not change public tool schemas, command names, flags, or compatibility aliases.
Do not touch roadmap/session/validation runtime behavior.
